purpose: Construct FAISS indexes with verified dimensions, recall and safe artifacts.

trigger: Build an IVF FAISS index from these embeddings
Evaluate FAISS nearest-neighbor recall on held-out vectors
Persist a local FAISS index for later retrieval
do_not_trigger: Send an email about this experiment

preflight: Confirm vector dimension, metric, normalization and training split.
Select a memory/CPU/GPU budget and permitted output path.
workflow: Train index only when index family requires it.
Add stable vector IDs and test deterministic nearest neighbors.
Measure recall/latency against exact baseline for approximate indexes.
Save index artifact and verify dimensions, count and load roundtrip.

evidence.how_to_verify: Record shape, dtype, metric, normalization and splits.
Verify local FAISS artifact reload, count, dimension and file hash.
Measure recall on held-out exact nearest neighbor labels.

failure_modes: Do not misstate approximate recall as exact accuracy.
If OOM, stop and reduce index size in an isolated worktree, not system settings.
